ways.label: Kepler Track full track
evidence: The track begins with a stroll through the beech forest along the shore of Lake Te Anau, the largest body of fresh water in Australasia, to Brod Bay.
The track then follows the Waiau River terrace to the swing bridge at Rainbow Reach.
Continue alongside the Waiau River to the Kepler Track car park.

doubts: No feature or name entry is the Kepler Track car park, so the start/end ref is null. Direction is not stated as clockwise/anticlockwise, though the page describes the track car park - Brod Bay - Luxmore - Iris Burn - Moturau - Rainbow Reach order. The four linked day walks are separate DOC walk pages covering parts of this track; listed as other walks rather than ways. Luxmore Cave side trip is reached by a signposted track from the hut (possibly T2 Luxmore Caves Track) but its ref is left null. Luxmore summit taken as Mount Luxmore (T13). Rainbow Reach in via referenced to the river name T14; the Rainbow Reach car park access point to road end F1 on Rainbow Reach Road. Shelters at Forest Burn, Hanging Valley and Rocky Point are not listed as huts (no bunks stated).
